limitations: Stable scope: macOS 15.7.1 arm64, OpenCode 2.3.2 local CLI/server and targeted PTY. 2.2.2/2.3.0 have automated compatibility coverage only; other platforms/versions are unverified.
The adapter has no equivalent SessionStart/Stop/failure/session-end business hook guarantee. Native tool/session hooks are used for binding and project diagnostics; idle never completes a stage.
Telemetry is consent-gated stage facts and workflow traces only. Native conversation, token usage and unobserved tool counts remain unavailable; no transcript files are read.
Task tracking is emulated by scripts/task_plan.py over canonical tasks.md, with optimistic receipts, dependency validation and atomic updates; stage completion still requires workflow verification.

Native project settings hooks remain unsupported (settings_file=null). Plugin-level project_checks run existing invariant/spec-sync linters after successful native write/edit/patch; shell changes still require explicit checks.
Workspace Apply RepoJobs use delegation_policy=may_delegate; OpenCode defaults to subagent depth 1, so set experimental.subagent_depth to at least 2.
D2C has an explicit owner-bound evidence gate; native skill-scoped Stop/question hooks are not provided. The audit does not authenticate browser provenance or replace visual acceptance.

Absolute-directory installation is supported. /helix:update can update clean attached Git checkouts with an explicit upstream through the consent protocol, pinned to an immutable fast-forward target. Dirty/detached/package-managed copies require manual handling; restart after updating.
Production projects, unattended model reliability, full desktop UI, full D2C visual fidelity, and real Kotlin/Groovy or multi-module compiler acceptance are outside this Stable scope.
